fields.label: Transition Id
fields.description: Per workflow/stage - NEVER a global constant.

fields.label: Process Action
fields.description: Provider action code for this transition (eContract: e.g. WfFunctionRunSignedOther). Captured from the provider portal - never invented.

fields.label: Sign Type
fields.description: Provider signature-type slug (eContract: e.g. ky-tham-gia). Must match the signature template the user owns.

fields.label: So chu ky da co truoc buoc nay
fields.description: transitionId cua eContract chay theo THU TU BUOC, khong theo cap duyet ERP va khong theo nguoi. Do 02/09: 0=Trinh ky(-2), 1=duyet1(-9), 2=duyet2(-10), 3=duyet3(-11). De trong = dong mac dinh theo stage nhu cu.
